question: Which team won the 2025 UEFA-Champions League?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris Saint‑Germain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Paris Saint-Germain (PSG)** emerged as the champions of the **2024-25 UEFA Champions League**, marking a historic achievement for the club.
 
• The final match was held on **May 31, 2025**, at the iconic **Allianz Arena** in **Munich**, **Germany**.
 
• This victory represents **PSG's** first-ever **European Cup/UEFA Champions League** title, fulfilling a long-standing ambition for the **Paris**-based side.
 
• By winning this title, **PSG** became the second **French club** in history to win the prestigious trophy, following **Olympique de Marseille's** victory in **1993**.
 
• The **2025** final was the grand finale of the **70th season** of Europe's premier club football tournament and the **33rd season** since it was renamed the **UEFA Champions League**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **New Tournament Format:**
 
 
• The **2024–25** season introduced a revolutionary **"Swiss-style"** format, expanding the number of participating teams from **32 to 36**.
 
• In this new **League Phase**, each team played **eight matches** against eight different opponents (four at home and four away) instead of the traditional group stage.
 
• This format change aimed to increase the number of high-profile matches early in the competition and provided more revenue opportunities for the **UEFA** member associations.
 
 
 
• **Venue Details:**
 
 
• The **Allianz Arena**, home to **Bayern Munich**, hosted its second **Champions League** final in **2025**; the first was the famous **2012** "Finale dahoam."
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of approximately **75,000** for domestic matches and around **67,000** for international **UEFA** events.
 
 
 
• **Managerial Success:**
 
 
• The team was led by head coach **Luis Enrique**, who had previously won the tournament with **Barcelona** in **2015**.
 
• His tactical approach emphasized **possession-based football** and high-intensity pressing, which proved decisive throughout the **knockout stages**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Qualification and Rewards:**
 
 
• As the winners of the **2025 UEFA Champions League**, **PSG** automatically qualified for the **2025–26 UEFA Champions League** league stage.
 
• They also earned the right to play against the winners of the **2024–25 UEFA Europa League** in the **2025 UEFA Super Cup**.
 
• Furthermore, the victory ensured their participation in the expanded **2025 FIFA Club World Cup** scheduled to be held in the **United States**.
 
 
 
• **Financial Impact:**
 
 
• The winner of the tournament received a base prize of **€20 million** for the final victory, in addition to accumulated bonuses from earlier rounds, totaling over **€100 million** in overall revenue.
 
• The **UEFA Champions League** remains the most lucrative club competition in world sports, with total distributions exceeding **€2.4 billion** for the **2024-25** cycle.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• The **2025** season marked a shift in European football hierarchy, as **PSG** overcame perennial giants like **Real Madrid** and **Manchester City** during their path to the trophy.
 
• Key players such as **Ousmane Dembélé**, **Vitinha**, and **Bradley Barcola** played pivotal roles in the club's successful campaign.
